scope: Supplemental policy for separately preserved initial and targeted retry receipts; no old receipt edited
raw_source_preservation: Byte-exact helper sources preserved before compilation in each cohort source-tool-snapshot/
raw_commands: Each profile has command-before-launch.json and command.json with real class inventories; stdout/stderr and before/after snapshots retained.
class_binding: Every generated .class, including record/nested classes, hashed before launch and compared after actual execution. Compiled stages removed.
read_binding: Python snapshots use reviewed O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK regular descriptors, pre-read metadata caps, bounded/streamed reads, and post-read descriptor/path identity checks. Java owned-byte reader is separately bounded at129 sentinel bytes and no-follow; not claimed to implement Python NONBLOCK descriptor identity checks.
budget_limit: 128 MiB aggregate explicitly covers fixed trusted SDK jar/source closure exceeding32 MiB; per-file cap32 MiB unchanged. This does not alter independent processor-admission32 MiB total source budgets.
snapshot_limit: Interval observations, not filesystem locks or protection against adversarial restore races. Snapshots include unselected sibling data, not admitted execution profiles or an exact IO trace.
authentication_limit: Pins installed source/resource/host-code bytes and observed SDK version; no upstream commit, SDK archive signature, every JDK dynamic library, or CPU semantic authentication.
historical_planning_source: Planning helper source hash remains historical and separately labeled in v1 receipts; current admission helper hash recorded from actually read source.
profile_scope: Only the13 released owned fixed language/compiler pairs executed. Original3 pilot inputs/provenance/tools remain unchanged. Resource admission does not mean native backend acceptance.
function_truth_limit: Manual byte extents fixed before ProgramDB. Ghidra function creation is explicitly seeded, not an autonomous-discovery precision/recall claim.
context_limit: Standalone default-context and flowed ProgramDB rows both retained; differing skip/delay/packet context must not be forced into native-pipeline agreement.
cpu_C_model_ABI: Unknown or not authenticated; no decompilation. PIC PCLATH-dependent computed call and all address-space units are preserved as observed, never inferred from pointer shifts.
retry_policy: Exactly13 initial profile executions, then only2 source-diagnosed v2 attempts. No bytes changed; all initial failures retained.
